texts: mixed: the content is all there (Hesper as reporter, essence production as what is reported, the Council as addressee, one report per full moon), but the trigger clause is a bare state — "the moon is full" — so the rule waits for a reified full-moon state rather than an event, and a later plain sentence such as "The moon is full." produces only the flat form and would never fire it. Give the trigger a verb so each full moon is an occurrence the rule can bind: "Whenever the moon becomes full, Hesper reports essence production to the Council."
